artifact:
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management

  Scenario: Doorstop stores requirements in a permanent and secure manner
    Given a requirement document is created
    When the requirement is saved using Doorstop
    Then the requirement is stored in a permanent and secure location

  Scenario: Doorstop handles change management of the requirements
    Given a requirement document exists with an initial version
    When a change is made to the requirement
    Then the requirement document is updated with the new version

  Scenario: Doorstop associates requirements changes to existing developer identification
    Given a requirement document exists
    When a change is made to the requirement by a developer
    Then the change is associated with the developer's identification

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop is scalable to support thousands of requirements
    Given <number_of_requirements> requirements are added to Doorstop
    When the system processes the requirements
    Then the system handles the requirements without performance degradation
    Examples:
      | number_of_requirements |
      | 1000                   |
      | 5000                   |
      | 10000                  |

  Scenario: Doorstop provides a lightweight installation method
    Given a clean system environment
    When Doorstop is installed
    Then the installation process is lightweight and completes successfully
